_note: Boost kinds (scripts/core/boosts.gd). Every multiplier on a kind comes from a source (toys now; book, knacks, kitchen later) as a part { source, id, x }; parts from every source multiply. `all`: an 'all' toy counts for this kind. 'automation' speeds every timed automation job: your pet's crank and box opening (in and out of sight) and the workers' machines and tables; adventures run on the trip's own clock. Only knacks feed spots (lead chance), trip (trip time divided), tough (hurt and injured counts divided), safe (lost counts divided), finds (extra bits and parts), pickups (trail pickups), treats (treat zoom), away (time away counts more: errands, the crank, the coin trickle), rummage (rummage coins), shiny (shiny capsule chance), pet_boxes (pet box weight) and power (the dungeon army's power, data/dungeon.json; gear never counts there) so far; the wisps perks (data/perks.json, source 'perks') feed power, coins and their own kinds: front (the front row's cards in the dungeon), herd_power (pets walking behind: the herd and cards past the front row), cellar (the army's power on the cellar's floors), stairs (on the stairs further down and in the sewing room's rooms), lanterns (wisps from the dungeon and the sewing room) and pets (box opening: your pet's, in and out of sight, and the workers' box tables); the adventure kinds are packed on a trip when it sets off (RunState.knacks). `sources` and `name` are the order and wording for the boost receipt later (not shown yet).
